name: Prompt Injection
meaning: text the developer did not write steers the model

name: Sensitive Information Disclosure
meaning: personal data or secrets reach a reply, a log or a provider

name: Supply Chain
meaning: a model, dataset or package from somewhere else is not what it claims

name: Data and Model Poisoning
meaning: the data a model learns or retrieves from was tampered with

name: Improper Output Handling
meaning: a reply is used by other code without being checked

name: Excessive Agency
meaning: an agent can do more than its task needs

name: System Prompt Leakage
meaning: the instructions, or what is hidden in them, reach a client

name: Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
meaning: the store a model retrieves from leaks or is tampered with

name: Misinformation
meaning: a confident answer is false and somebody acts on it

name: Unbounded Consumption
meaning: one user or one loop spends without limit
